title: "residual_fit_for_nutrients"
format: html

```{r, warning=FALSE}
library(sf); library(sp); library(randomForest); library(gstat)
library(dplyr); library(purrr); library(tibble); library(ggplot2)

# --- Load data ---
covariate_stack <- rast("../LOCAL DATA DO NOT PUSH/covariate_stack/covariate_stack_3m.tif")
soil_covariate_data_scaled_SP <- read.csv("../LOCAL DATA DO NOT PUSH/covariates_and_soil_data/soil_covariate_data_scaled_SP.csv")
soil_covariate_data_scaled_C  <- read.csv("../LOCAL DATA DO NOT PUSH/covariates_and_soil_data/soil_covariate_data_scaled_C.csv")
soil_vars <- c("lbc_1", "lb_ceq", "p_h_2", "ca", "k", "mg", "mn", "p", "zn")
covariates <- setdiff(names(soil_covariate_data_scaled_SP), c("x","y",soil_vars))

# --- Convert to sf and transform to UTM ---
soil_sf_SP <- st_as_sf(soil_covariate_data_scaled_SP, coords = c("x","y"), crs = 4326) %>% st_transform(32617)
soil_sf_C  <- st_as_sf(soil_covariate_data_scaled_C, coords = c("x","y"), crs = 4326) %>% st_transform(32617)

# Plot RF residual variograms for SP and C (one row per nutrient, SP left, C right)
required_pkgs <- c("sf","sp","randomForest","gstat","dplyr","purrr","tibble","ggplot2","gridExtra")
new <- required_pkgs[!(required_pkgs %in% installed.packages()[, "Package"])]
if(length(new)) install.packages(new, dependencies = TRUE)
library(sf); library(sp); library(randomForest); library(gstat)
library(dplyr); library(purrr); library(tibble); library(ggplot2); library(gridExtra)

candidate_models <- c("Exp","Sph","Gau","Mat")
min_points_for_vario <- 8
rf_ntree <- 500   # change if you want more trees

# helper: fit candidate variograms and return best (by SSE)
fit_variogram_best <- function(spdf, value_col, candidate_models=c("Exp","Sph","Gau","Mat")){
  out <- list(emp = NULL, best_fit = NULL, model = NA_character_, range = NA_real_, sill = NA_real_, nugget = NA_real_, sse = NA_real_, n_pairs = NA_integer_, line_df = NULL)
  fmla <- as.formula(paste(value_col, "~ 1"))
  v_emp <- tryCatch(variogram(fmla, data = spdf), error = function(e) NULL)
  if(is.null(v_emp) || nrow(v_emp)==0) return(out)
  out$emp <- v_emp
  out$n_pairs <- sum(v_emp$np, na.rm = TRUE)
  samp_var <- tryCatch(var(spdf[[value_col]], na.rm = TRUE), error = function(e) NA_real_)
  maxdist <- max(v_emp$dist, na.rm = TRUE)
  best_sse <- Inf; best_fit <- NULL; best_name <- NA_character_; best_line <- NULL
  for(m in candidate_models){
    init_vgm <- tryCatch({
      if(m=="Mat") vgm(psill = max(1e-6, samp_var*0.8), model = "Mat", range = maxdist/3, kappa = 0.5)
      else vgm(psill = max(1e-6, samp_var*0.8), model = m, range = maxdist/3)
    }, error = function(e) vgm(model = m))
    fit_try <- tryCatch(fit.variogram(v_emp, model = init_vgm), error = function(e) NULL)
    if(is.null(fit_try)) next
    theo <- tryCatch(variogramLine(fit_try, dist_vector = v_emp$dist), error = function(e) NULL)
    if(is.null(theo)) next
    theo_gamma <- approx(x = theo$dist, y = theo$gamma, xout = v_emp$dist, rule = 2)$y
    sse <- sum((v_emp$gamma - theo_gamma)^2, na.rm = TRUE)
    if(is.finite(sse) && sse < best_sse){
      best_sse <- sse; best_fit <- fit_try; best_name <- m
      best_line <- data.frame(dist = theo$dist, gamma = theo$gamma)
    }
  }
  if(!is.null(best_fit)){
    out$best_fit <- best_fit
    out$model <- best_name
    fit_df <- tryCatch(as.data.frame(best_fit), error = function(e) NULL)
    if(!is.null(fit_df) && nrow(fit_df) >= 1){
      nug_rows <- which(tolower(fit_df$model) %in% c("nug","nugget"))
      out$nugget <- if(length(nug_rows)>0) as.numeric(fit_df$psill[nug_rows[1]]) else 0
      struct_rows <- which(!(tolower(fit_df$model) %in% c("nug","nugget")))
      if(length(struct_rows)>0){
        out$sill <- as.numeric(fit_df$psill[struct_rows[1]])
        out$range <- as.numeric(fit_df$range[struct_rows[1]])
      } else {
        out$sill <- 0; out$range <- NA_real_
      }
    }
    out$sse <- best_sse
    out$line_df <- best_line
  }
  out
}

# loop nutrients and plot
for(nut in soil_vars){
  plots_pair <- list()
  for(ds_name in c("SP","C")){
    soil_sf <- if(ds_name=="SP") soil_sf_SP else soil_sf_C
    # prepare data: only rows with complete covariates + target
    df_full <- soil_sf %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% select(all_of(c(covariates, nut)))
    keep <- stats::complete.cases(df_full)
    df_use <- df_full[keep, , drop = FALSE]
    n_pts <- nrow(df_use)
    if(n_pts < 3){
      p <- ggplot() + annotate("text", x=0.5, y=0.5, label = paste("Too few points for", ds_name, nut, "\n(n=", n_pts,")"), size=5) + theme_void()
      plots_pair[[ds_name]] <- p
      next
    }
    # fit RF
    rf_mod <- tryCatch(randomForest::randomForest(x = df_use[, covariates, drop=FALSE], y = df_use[[nut]], ntree = rf_ntree), error = function(e) NULL)
    if(is.null(rf_mod)){
      p <- ggplot() + annotate("text", x=0.5, y=0.5, label = paste("RF failed:", ds_name, nut), size=5) + theme_void()
      plots_pair[[ds_name]] <- p
      next
    }
    pred_oob <- tryCatch(rf_mod$predicted, error = function(e) NULL)
    pred_fitted <- tryCatch(predict(rf_mod, newdata = df_use[, covariates, drop = FALSE]), error = function(e) NULL)
    used_pred <- if(!is.null(pred_oob) && length(pred_oob)==n_pts) pred_oob else pred_fitted
    resid <- df_use[[nut]] - used_pred

    # create sf of residuals using original coords
    coords <- st_coordinates(soil_sf)[keep, , drop = FALSE]
    resid_sf <- st_as_sf(tibble::tibble(obs = df_use[[nut]], predicted = used_pred, residual = resid, x = coords[,1], y = coords[,2]), coords = c("x","y"), crs = st_crs(soil_sf))

    # prepare Spatial object for variogram
    sp_res <- tryCatch(as(resid_sf %>% rename(resid_col = residual), "Spatial"), error = function(e) NULL)
    if(is.null(sp_res) || sum(!is.na(sp_res$resid_col)) < min_points_for_vario){
      p <- ggplot() + annotate("text", x=0.5, y=0.5, label = paste("Not enough points for variogram:", ds_name, nut, "\n(n=", n_pts,")"), size=4) + theme_void()
      plots_pair[[ds_name]] <- p
      next
    }

    vf <- fit_variogram_best(sp_res, "resid_col", candidate_models = candidate_models)
    v_emp <- vf$emp
    # if no fit, show empirical semivariances only
    if(is.null(v_emp) || nrow(v_emp)==0){
      p <- ggplot() + annotate("text", x=0.5, y=0.5, label = paste("Empirical variogram failed:", ds_name, nut), size=4) + theme_void()
      plots_pair[[ds_name]] <- p
      next
    }
    v_emp_df <- as.data.frame(v_emp)
    p <- ggplot(v_emp_df, aes(x = dist, y = gamma)) +
      geom_point(size = 2) +
      geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=gamma - (sqrt(gamma)/2), ymax = gamma + (sqrt(gamma)/2)), width = 0, alpha=0.2) + # visual hint (not rigorous)
      labs(title = paste0(nut, " — ", ds_name), x = "Distance (m)", y = "Semivariance") +
      theme_minimal()
    if(!is.null(vf$line_df) && nrow(vf$line_df) > 1){
      p <- p + geom_line(data = vf$line_df, aes(x = dist, y = gamma), color = "red", size = 1)
      p <- p + annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, label = paste0("model=", vf$model, "\nrange=", round(vf$range,1), "\nsill=", round(vf$sill,2), "\nnugget=", round(vf$nugget,2)), hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1.05, size = 3)
    } else {
      p <- p + annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, label = "no theoretical fit", hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1.05, size = 3)
    }
    plots_pair[[ds_name]] <- p
  } # end datasets loop

  # arrange SP (left) and C (right) side-by-side and print
  grid.arrange(plots_pair[["SP"]], plots_pair[["C"]], ncol = 2)
  # pause between plots so user can inspect if running interactively
  if(interactive()) readline(prompt = "Press <enter> to continue to next nutrient...")
} # end nutrients loop

#save all plots:
```

```{r}
library(sf)
library(gstat)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)

# --- Load data ---

SP_with_soil_CN <- read.csv("../LOCAL DATA DO NOT PUSH/covariates_and_soil_data/soil_covariate_data_scaled_SP_with_CN.csv")
C_with_soil_CN  <- read.csv("../LOCAL DATA DO NOT PUSH/covariates_and_soil_data/soil_covariate_data_scaled_C_with_CN.csv")

# Convert to sf (UTM 17N)

soil_sf_SP_CN <- st_as_sf(SP_with_soil_CN, coords = c("x","y"), crs = 4326) %>% st_transform(32617)
soil_sf_C_CN  <- st_as_sf(C_with_soil_CN,  coords = c("x","y"), crs = 4326) %>% st_transform(32617)

# Define nutrients to process

soil_vars_CN <- c("lbc_1","lb_ceq","p_h_2","ca","k","mg","mn","p","zn","c","n")
candidate_models <- c("Exp","Sph","Gau","Mat")

# --- Helper: robust variogram fit ---

fit_variogram_best <- function(spdf, value_col, candidate_models){
out <- list(emp = NULL, best_fit = NULL, model = NA_character_,
range = NA_real_, sill = NA_real_, nugget = NA_real_, line_df = NULL)
fmla <- as.formula(paste(value_col, "~ 1"))
v_emp <- tryCatch(variogram(fmla, data = spdf), error = function(e) NULL)
if(is.null(v_emp) || nrow(v_emp) == 0) return(out)

var_val <- var(spdf[[value_col]], na.rm = TRUE)
maxdist <- max(v_emp$dist, na.rm = TRUE)
best_sse <- Inf

for(m in candidate_models){
init_vgm <- tryCatch({
if(m == "Mat") vgm(model = m, range = maxdist/3, psill = var_val*0.5, nugget = var_val*0.1, kappa = 0.5)
else vgm(model = m, range = maxdist/3, psill = var_val*0.5, nugget = var_val*0.1)
}, error = function(e) vgm(model = m))


fit_try <- tryCatch(
  fit.variogram(v_emp, model = init_vgm, fit.sill = TRUE, fit.range = TRUE, fit.method = 7),
  error = function(e) NULL
)

if(is.null(fit_try)) next

# skip nonsensical fits
ps <- as.data.frame(fit_try)
if(any(ps$range <= 0 | ps$psill < 0, na.rm = TRUE)) next

theo <- tryCatch(variogramLine(fit_try, dist_vector = v_emp$dist), error = function(e) NULL)
if(is.null(theo)) next

sse <- sum((v_emp$gamma - theo$gamma)^2, na.rm = TRUE)
if(sse < best_sse){
  best_sse <- sse
  out$best_fit <- fit_try
  out$model <- m
  out$line_df <- theo
}


}

if(!is.null(out$best_fit)){
ps <- as.data.frame(out$best_fit)
out$nugget <- if("Nug" %in% ps$model) ps$psill[ps$model=="Nug"] else 0
struct <- ps[ps$model != "Nug",]
if(nrow(struct)>0){
out$sill <- struct$psill[1]; out$range <- struct$range[1]
}
out$emp <- v_emp
}
out
}

# --- Loop and plot ---

for(nut in soil_vars_CN){
plots <- list()
for(ds_name in c("SP","C")){
soil_sf <- if(ds_name=="SP") soil_sf_SP_CN else soil_sf_C_CN
if(!nut %in% names(soil_sf)){
plots[[ds_name]] <- ggplot() +
annotate("text", x=0.5, y=0.5, label=paste("Missing", nut, "in", ds_name), size=5) + theme_void()
next
}

spdf <- as(soil_sf[,nut], "Spatial")
names(spdf@data) <- "value"
vf <- fit_variogram_best(spdf, "value", candidate_models)
v_emp <- vf$emp

if(is.null(v_emp)){
  plots[[ds_name]] <- ggplot() +
    annotate("text", x=0.5, y=0.5, label=paste("No variogram:", nut, ds_name), size=4) + theme_void()
  next
}

p <- ggplot(as.data.frame(v_emp), aes(x=dist, y=gamma)) +
  geom_point(size=2) +
  labs(title=paste(nut, "—", ds_name), x="Distance (m)", y="Semivariance") +
  theme_minimal()

if(!is.null(vf$line_df)){
  p <- p + geom_line(data=vf$line_df, aes(x=dist, y=gamma), color="red", size=1) +
    annotate("text", x=Inf, y=Inf, label=paste0("Model=", vf$model,
                                                "\nRange=", round(vf$range,1),
                                                "\nSill=", round(vf$sill,2),
                                                "\nNugget=", round(vf$nugget,2)),
             hjust=1.1, vjust=1.1, size=3)
} else {
  p <- p + annotate("text", x=Inf, y=Inf, label="No valid fit", hjust=1.1, vjust=1.1, size=3)
}
plots[[ds_name]] <- p


}
grid.arrange(plots$SP, plots$C, ncol=2)
if(interactive()) readline(prompt="Press <Enter> for next nutrient...")
}
```

```{r}

library(sf); library(sp); library(randomForest); library(gstat)
library(dplyr); library(purrr); library(tibble); library(ggplot2); library(gridExtra)
library(terra)

#--- Load data ---

covariate_stack <- rast("../LOCAL DATA DO NOT PUSH/covariate_stack/covariate_stack_3m.tif")
soil_covariate_data_scaled_SP_CN <- read.csv("../LOCAL DATA DO NOT PUSH/covariates_and_soil_data/soil_covariate_data_scaled_SP_with_CN.csv")
soil_covariate_data_scaled_C_CN <- read.csv("../LOCAL DATA DO NOT PUSH/covariates_and_soil_data/soil_covariate_data_scaled_C_with_CN.csv")

#--- Define soil and covariate variables ---

soil_vars_CN <- c("lbc_1","lb_ceq","p_h_2","ca","k","mg","mn","p","zn","c","n")
covariates_CN <- setdiff(names(soil_covariate_data_scaled_SP_CN), c("x","y",soil_vars_CN))

#--- Convert to sf and project to UTM ---

soil_sf_SP_CN <- st_as_sf(soil_covariate_data_scaled_SP_CN, coords=c("x","y"), crs=4326) %>% st_transform(32617)
soil_sf_C_CN <- st_as_sf(soil_covariate_data_scaled_C_CN, coords=c("x","y"), crs=4326) %>% st_transform(32617)

#--- Parameters ---

candidate_models <- c("Exp","Sph","Gau","Mat")
min_points_for_vario <- 8
rf_ntree <- 500

#--- Helper: fit candidate variograms and return best (by SSE) ---

fit_variogram_best <- function(spdf, value_col, candidate_models=c("Exp","Sph","Gau","Mat")){
out <- list(emp = NULL, best_fit = NULL, model = NA_character_, range = NA_real_, sill = NA_real_, nugget = NA_real_, sse = NA_real_, line_df = NULL)
fmla <- as.formula(paste(value_col, "~ 1"))
v_emp <- tryCatch(variogram(fmla, data = spdf), error=function(e) NULL)
if(is.null(v_emp) || nrow(v_emp)==0) return(out)
samp_var <- var(spdf[[value_col]], na.rm=TRUE)
maxdist <- max(v_emp$dist, na.rm=TRUE)
best_sse <- Inf
for(m in candidate_models){
init_vgm <- tryCatch({
if(m=="Mat") vgm(psill=max(1e-6, samp_var0.8), model="Mat", range=maxdist/3, kappa=0.5)
else vgm(psill=max(1e-6, samp_var0.8), model=m, range=maxdist/3)
}, error=function(e) vgm(model=m))
fit_try <- tryCatch(fit.variogram(v_emp, model=init_vgm), error=function(e) NULL)
if(is.null(fit_try)) next
ps <- as.data.frame(fit_try)
if(any(ps$range<=0 | ps$psill<0, na.rm=TRUE)) next
theo <- tryCatch(variogramLine(fit_try, dist_vector=v_emp$dist), error=function(e) NULL)
if(is.null(theo)) next
sse <- sum((v_emp$gamma - theo$gamma)^2, na.rm=TRUE)
if(sse < best_sse){
best_sse <- sse
out$best_fit <- fit_try
out$model <- m
out$line_df <- data.frame(dist=theo$dist, gamma=theo$gamma)
}
}
if(!is.null(out$best_fit)){
fit_df <- as.data.frame(out$best_fit)
nug_rows <- which(tolower(fit_df$model) %in% c("nug","nugget"))
out$nugget <- if(length(nug_rows)>0) as.numeric(fit_df$psill[nug_rows[1]]) else 0
struct_rows <- which(!(tolower(fit_df$model) %in% c("nug","nugget")))
if(length(struct_rows)>0){
out$sill <- as.numeric(fit_df$psill[struct_rows[1]])
out$range <- as.numeric(fit_df$range[struct_rows[1]])
}
out$sse <- best_sse
out$emp <- v_emp
}
out
}

#--- Loop through nutrients ---

for(nut in soil_vars_CN){
plots_pair <- list()
for(ds_name in c("SP","C")){
soil_sf <- if(ds_name=="SP") soil_sf_SP_CN else soil_sf_C_CN
df_full <- soil_sf %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% select(all_of(c(covariates_CN, nut)))
keep <- complete.cases(df_full)
df_use <- df_full[keep, , drop=FALSE]
n_pts <- nrow(df_use)
if(n_pts < 3){
p <- ggplot() + annotate("text", x=0.5, y=0.5, label=paste("Too few points for", ds_name, nut), size=5) + theme_void()
plots_pair[[ds_name]] <- p
next
}

# --- Fit random forest ---
rf_mod <- tryCatch(randomForest(x=df_use[,covariates_CN,drop=FALSE], y=df_use[[nut]], ntree=rf_ntree), error=function(e) NULL)
if(is.null(rf_mod)){
  p <- ggplot() + annotate("text", x=0.5, y=0.5, label=paste("RF failed:", ds_name, nut), size=5) + theme_void()
  plots_pair[[ds_name]] <- p
  next
}

# --- Residuals ---
pred_oob <- tryCatch(rf_mod$predicted, error=function(e) NULL)
pred_fitted <- tryCatch(predict(rf_mod, newdata=df_use[,covariates_CN,drop=FALSE]), error=function(e) NULL)
used_pred <- if(!is.null(pred_oob) && length(pred_oob)==n_pts) pred_oob else pred_fitted
resid <- df_use[[nut]] - used_pred

coords <- st_coordinates(soil_sf)[keep, , drop=FALSE]
resid_sf <- st_as_sf(tibble(obs=df_use[[nut]], predicted=used_pred, residual=resid, x=coords[,1], y=coords[,2]), coords=c("x","y"), crs=st_crs(soil_sf))
sp_res <- tryCatch(as(resid_sf %>% rename(resid_col=residual), "Spatial"), error=function(e) NULL)
if(is.null(sp_res) || sum(!is.na(sp_res$resid_col)) < min_points_for_vario){
  p <- ggplot() + annotate("text", x=0.5, y=0.5, label=paste("Not enough points for variogram:", ds_name, nut, "\n(n=", n_pts,")"), size=4) + theme_void()
  plots_pair[[ds_name]] <- p
  next
}

vf <- fit_variogram_best(sp_res, "resid_col", candidate_models)
v_emp <- vf$emp
if(is.null(v_emp) || nrow(v_emp)==0){
  p <- ggplot() + annotate("text", x=0.5, y=0.5, label=paste("Empirical variogram failed:", ds_name, nut), size=4) + theme_void()
  plots_pair[[ds_name]] <- p
  next
}

v_emp_df <- as.data.frame(v_emp)
p <- ggplot(v_emp_df, aes(x=dist, y=gamma)) +
  geom_point(size=2) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=gamma - (sqrt(gamma)/2), ymax=gamma + (sqrt(gamma)/2)), width=0, alpha=0.2) +
  labs(title=paste0(nut," — ",ds_name), x="Distance (m)", y="Semivariance") +
  theme_minimal()

if(!is.null(vf$line_df) && nrow(vf$line_df)>1){
  p <- p + geom_line(data=vf$line_df, aes(x=dist, y=gamma), color="red", size=1) +
    annotate("text", x=Inf, y=Inf, label=paste0("model=",vf$model,"\nrange=",round(vf$range,1),"\nsill=",round(vf$sill,2),"\nnugget=",round(vf$nugget,2)), hjust=1.05, vjust=1.05, size=3)
} else {
  p <- p + annotate("text", x=Inf, y=Inf, label="no theoretical fit", hjust=1.05, vjust=1.05, size=3)
}
plots_pair[[ds_name]] <- p

}

#--- Display side-by-side ---

grid.arrange(plots_pair$SP, plots_pair$C, ncol=2)
if(interactive()) readline(prompt="Press to continue to next nutrient...")
}
```

```{r}
# --- Load libraries ---


library(sf); library(sp); library(randomForest); library(gstat)
library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(purrr); library(tibble)

# --- Load data ---

covariate_stack <- rast("../LOCAL DATA DO NOT PUSH/covariate_stack/covariate_stack_3m.tif")
SP_with_soil_CN <- read.csv("../LOCAL DATA DO NOT PUSH/covariates_and_soil_data/soil_covariate_data_scaled_SP_with_CN.csv")
C_with_soil_CN  <- read.csv("../LOCAL DATA DO NOT PUSH/covariates_and_soil_data/soil_covariate_data_scaled_C_with_CN.csv")

# --- Define variables ---

soil_vars <- c("lbc_1","lb_ceq","p_h_2","ca","k","mg","mn","p","zn","c","n")
covariates <- setdiff(names(SP_with_soil_CN), c("x","y",soil_vars))

# --- Convert to sf ---

soil_sf_SP <- st_as_sf(SP_with_soil_CN, coords=c("x","y"), crs=4326) %>% st_transform(32617)
soil_sf_C  <- st_as_sf(C_with_soil_CN,  coords=c("x","y"), crs=4326) %>% st_transform(32617)

# --- Detect and remove multi-nutrient outliers ---

SP_vals <- SP_with_soil_CN %>% select(x,y,all_of(soil_vars)) %>% mutate(dataset="SP")
C_vals  <- C_with_soil_CN  %>% select(x,y,all_of(soil_vars)) %>% mutate(dataset="Composite")

soil_long <- bind_rows(SP_vals, C_vals) %>%
pivot_longer(all_of(soil_vars), names_to="variable", values_to="value") %>%
pivot_wider(names_from=dataset, values_from=value) %>%
drop_na(SP, Composite)

soil_outliers <- soil_long %>%
group_by(variable) %>%
mutate(z = abs(scale(SP - Composite))) %>%
ungroup() %>%
mutate(outlier = z > 2)

multi_outliers <- soil_outliers %>%
group_by(x, y) %>%
summarise(n_outlier = sum(outlier, na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
filter(n_outlier >= 3)

cat("Removed", nrow(multi_outliers), "multi-nutrient outlier points.\n")

# --- Filter sf data to remove multi-outlier points ---

remove_pts <- multi_outliers %>% select(x,y)
soil_sf_SP <- soil_sf_SP %>%
mutate(x = st_coordinates(.)[,1],
y = st_coordinates(.)[,2]) %>%
anti_join(remove_pts, by=c("x","y")) %>%
select(-x,-y)

soil_sf_C <- soil_sf_C %>%
mutate(x = st_coordinates(.)[,1],
y = st_coordinates(.)[,2]) %>%
anti_join(remove_pts, by=c("x","y")) %>%
select(-x,-y)

cat("Remaining SP:", nrow(soil_sf_SP), "points | C:", nrow(soil_sf_C), "points\n")

# --- Parameters ---

candidate_models <- c("Exp","Sph","Gau","Mat")
min_points_for_vario <- 8
rf_ntree <- 500

# --- Helper: fit candidate variograms ---

fit_variogram_best <- function(spdf, value_col, candidate_models=c("Exp","Sph","Gau","Mat")){
out <- list(emp=NULL, best_fit=NULL, model=NA_character_, range=NA_real_,
sill=NA_real_, nugget=NA_real_, sse=NA_real_, line_df=NULL)
fmla <- as.formula(paste(value_col, "~ 1"))
v_emp <- tryCatch(variogram(fmla, data=spdf), error=function(e) NULL)
if(is.null(v_emp)||nrow(v_emp)==0) return(out)
samp_var <- var(spdf[[value_col]], na.rm=TRUE)
maxdist <- max(v_emp$dist, na.rm=TRUE)
best_sse <- Inf
for(m in candidate_models){
init_vgm <- tryCatch({
if(m=="Mat") vgm(psill=max(1e-6,samp_var*0.8),model="Mat",range=maxdist/3,kappa=0.5)
else vgm(psill=max(1e-6,samp_var*0.8),model=m,range=maxdist/3)
}, error=function(e) vgm(model=m))
fit_try <- tryCatch(fit.variogram(v_emp, model=init_vgm), error=function(e) NULL)
if(is.null(fit_try)) next
ps <- as.data.frame(fit_try)
if(any(ps$range<=0 | ps$psill<0, na.rm=TRUE)) next
theo <- tryCatch(variogramLine(fit_try, dist_vector=v_emp$dist), error=function(e) NULL)
if(is.null(theo)) next
sse <- sum((v_emp$gamma - theo$gamma)^2, na.rm=TRUE)
if(sse < best_sse){
best_sse <- sse
out$best_fit <- fit_try
out$model <- m
out$line_df <- data.frame(dist=theo$dist, gamma=theo$gamma)
}
}
if(!is.null(out$best_fit)){
fit_df <- as.data.frame(out$best_fit)
nug_rows <- which(tolower(fit_df$model) %in% c("nug","nugget"))
out$nugget <- if(length(nug_rows)>0) as.numeric(fit_df$psill[nug_rows[1]]) else 0
struct_rows <- which(!(tolower(fit_df$model) %in% c("nug","nugget")))
if(length(struct_rows)>0){
out$sill <- as.numeric(fit_df$psill[struct_rows[1]])
out$range <- as.numeric(fit_df$range[struct_rows[1]])
}
out$sse <- best_sse
out$emp <- v_emp
}
out
}

# --- Main loop: RF residuals + variogram fits ---
```

```{r}
#variogram fitting for raw data:
# ============================================================
# RAW VARIOGRAMS FOR ALL NUTRIENTS (INCLUDING C & N)
# ============================================================

library(sf); library(sp); library(gstat)
library(dplyr); library(tibble)
library(ggplot2); library(gridExtra)

candidate_models <- c("Exp","Sph","Gau","Mat")
min_points_for_vario <- 8

fit_variogram_best <- function(spdf, value_col, candidate_models=c("Exp","Sph","Gau","Mat")){
  out <- list(emp=NULL,best_fit=NULL,model=NA_character_,
              range=NA_real_,sill=NA_real_,nugget=NA_real_,
              sse=NA_real_,line_df=NULL)
  
  # Build formula safely
  fmla <- as.formula(paste(value_col, "~ 1"))
  
  v_emp <- tryCatch(variogram(fmla, data=spdf), error=function(e)NULL)
  if(is.null(v_emp) || nrow(v_emp)==0) return(out)
  
  samp_var <- var(spdf[[value_col]], na.rm=TRUE)
  maxdist <- max(v_emp$dist, na.rm=TRUE)
  best_sse <- Inf
  
  for(m in candidate_models){
    init_vgm <- tryCatch({
      if(m=="Mat") vgm(psill=max(1e-6,samp_var*0.8), model="Mat", range=maxdist/3, kappa=0.5)
      else vgm(psill=max(1e-6,samp_var*0.8), model=m, range=maxdist/3)
    }, error=function(e) vgm(model=m))
    
    fit_try <- tryCatch(fit.variogram(v_emp, model=init_vgm), error=function(e)NULL)
    if(is.null(fit_try)) next
    
    ps <- as.data.frame(fit_try)
    if(any(ps$range<=0 | ps$psill<0, na.rm=TRUE)) next
    
    theo <- tryCatch(variogramLine(fit_try, dist_vector=v_emp$dist), error=function(e)NULL)
    if(is.null(theo)) next
    
    sse <- sum((v_emp$gamma - theo$gamma)^2, na.rm=TRUE)
    if(is.finite(sse) && sse < best_sse){
      best_sse <- sse
      out$best_fit <- fit_try
      out$model <- m
      out$line_df <- data.frame(dist=theo$dist, gamma=theo$gamma)
    }
  }
  
  if(!is.null(out$best_fit)){
    fit_df <- as.data.frame(out$best_fit)
    nug_rows <- which(tolower(fit_df$model) %in% c("nug","nugget"))
    out$nugget <- if(length(nug_rows)>0) as.numeric(fit_df$psill[nug_rows[1]]) else 0
    struct_rows <- which(!(tolower(fit_df$model) %in% c("nug","nugget")))
    if(length(struct_rows)>0){
      out$sill <- as.numeric(fit_df$psill[struct_rows[1]])
      out$range <- as.numeric(fit_df$range[struct_rows[1]])
    }
    out$sse <- best_sse
  }
  out$emp <- v_emp
  out
}

# --- Loop through nutrients (raw data variograms) ---
for(nut in soil_vars){
  plots_pair <- list()
  for(ds_name in c("SP","C")){
    soil_sf <- if(ds_name=="SP") soil_sf_SP else soil_sf_C
    
    if(!nut %in% names(soil_sf)){
      plots_pair[[ds_name]] <- ggplot() +
        annotate("text",x=0.5,y=0.5,label=paste("Missing",nut,"in",ds_name),size=5) + theme_void()
      next
    }
    
    # --- rename "c" and "n" temporarily to safe names ---
    safe_col <- nut
    temp_name <- case_when(
      nut == "c" ~ "carbon",
      nut == "n" ~ "nitrogen",
      TRUE ~ nut
    )
    
    # copy sf and rename column
    soil_temp <- soil_sf %>% rename(!!temp_name := all_of(nut))
    spdf <- as(soil_temp[, temp_name], "Spatial")
    
    if(sum(!is.na(spdf[[temp_name]])) < min_points_for_vario){
      plots_pair[[ds_name]] <- ggplot() +
        annotate("text",x=0.5,y=0.5,label=paste("Too few points for",nut,"in",ds_name),size=5) + theme_void()
      next
    }
    
    vf <- fit_variogram_best(spdf, temp_name, candidate_models)
    v_emp <- vf$emp
    
    # --- handle no empirical variogram gracefully ---
    if(is.null(v_emp) || nrow(v_emp)==0){
      p <- ggplot() + annotate("text",x=0.5,y=0.5,label=paste("No variogram data for",nut,"(",ds_name,")"),size=4) + theme_void()
      plots_pair[[ds_name]] <- p
      next
    }
    
    v_emp_df <- as.data.frame(v_emp)
    p <- ggplot(v_emp_df, aes(x=dist, y=gamma)) +
      geom_point(size=2) +
      labs(title=paste0(nut," — ",ds_name," (raw data)"),
           x="Distance (m)", y="Semivariance") +
      theme_minimal()
    
    if(!is.null(vf$line_df) && nrow(vf$line_df)>1){
      p <- p + geom_line(data=vf$line_df, aes(x=dist, y=gamma), color="red", size=1) +
        annotate("text",x=Inf,y=Inf,
                 label=paste0("model=",vf$model,
                              "\nrange=",round(vf$range,1),
                              "\nsill=",round(vf$sill,2),
                              "\nnugget=",round(vf$nugget,2)),
                 hjust=1.05,vjust=1.05,size=3)
    } else {
      p <- p + annotate("text",x=Inf,y=Inf,label="no theoretical fit",
                        hjust=1.05,vjust=1.05,size=3)
    }
    
    plots_pair[[ds_name]] <- p
  }
  
  grid.arrange(plots_pair$SP, plots_pair$C, ncol=2)
  if(interactive()) readline(prompt="Press <Enter> for next nutrient...")
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# MANUAL EMPIRICAL SEMIVARIOGRAMS FOR C AND N (NO GSTAT)
# ============================================================

library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)

# Function to compute empirical semivariogram manually
manual_variogram <- function(sf_obj, value_col, n_lags = 15) {
  df <- sf_obj %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    select(all_of(value_col)) %>%
    mutate(x = st_coordinates(sf_obj)[,1],
           y = st_coordinates(sf_obj)[,2]) %>%
    drop_na()
  
  # pairwise distances and semivariances
  coords <- as.matrix(df[, c("x","y")])
  vals <- df[[value_col]]
  
  dmat <- as.matrix(dist(coords))
  vmat <- outer(vals, vals, "-")^2 / 2
  
  # extract upper triangle (unique pairs)
  dists <- dmat[upper.tri(dmat)]
  semivars <- vmat[upper.tri(vmat)]
  
  # bin by distance
  breaks <- seq(0, max(dists, na.rm = TRUE), length.out = n_lags + 1)
  bins <- cut(dists, breaks, include.lowest = TRUE)
  
  vario_df <- data.frame(
    dist = tapply(dists, bins, mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    gamma = tapply(semivars, bins, mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    np = tapply(semivars, bins, length)
  ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(dist), !is.na(gamma))
  
  return(vario_df)
}

# ============================================================
# Run for C and N
# ============================================================

for (nut in c("c", "n")) {
  plots_pair <- list()
  
  for (ds_name in c("SP","C")) {
    soil_sf <- if (ds_name == "SP") soil_sf_SP else soil_sf_C
    
    # rename safely
    temp_name <- ifelse(nut == "c", "carbon", "nitrogen")
    soil_temp <- soil_sf %>% rename(!!temp_name := all_of(nut))
    
    # compute manual variogram
    vario_df <- manual_variogram(soil_temp, temp_name, n_lags = 15)
    
    if (nrow(vario_df) == 0) {
      plots_pair[[ds_name]] <- ggplot() +
        annotate("text", x=0.5, y=0.5, label=paste("No semivariances for", nut, ds_name), size=5) +
        theme_void()
      next
    }
    
    # plot
    p <- ggplot(vario_df, aes(x = dist, y = gamma)) +
      geom_point(size = 2, color = "#3366AA") +
      geom_line(alpha = 0.5) +
      labs(
        title = paste0(toupper(nut), " — ", ds_name, " (Manual Empirical Variogram)"),
        x = "Distance (m)",
        y = "Semivariance"
      ) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
    
    plots_pair[[ds_name]] <- p
  }
  
  grid.arrange(plots_pair$SP, plots_pair$C, ncol = 2)
}

#fit variograms to C an N:

  plots_pair <- list()
  for(ds_name in c("SP","C")){
    soil_sf <- if(ds_name=="SP") soil_sf_SP else soil_sf_C

    spdf <- as(soil_temp[, temp_name], "Spatial")
    
    if(sum(!is.na(spdf[[temp_name]])) < min_points_for_vario){
      plots_pair[[ds_name]] <- ggplot() +
        annotate("text", x=0.5, y=0.5,
                 label=paste("Too few points for", nut, "in", ds_name),
                 size=5) + theme_void()

    }

    if(!is.null(vf$line_df) && nrow(vf$line_df)>1){
```
